name: Space Frame
desc: A structural plate of a two-plane space frame carrying rolling loads — every member is solved by relaxation and lit by its own axial force, blue in compression and red in tension, the whole span visibly sagging and shivering under the wheels while a deflection diagram traces the bottom chord below and callouts count the kilonewtons.

energy.doc: load magnitude + deflection exaggeration + member weight + shiver

scale.doc: span vs frame — 2.0 runs the truss off both edges

density.doc: number of bays (4..12) and how many loads roll at once (2..4)

speed.doc: how fast the loads traverse the span

hue.doc: plate tint (film/ghost); force colours stay blue/red by convention

depth.doc: axonometric separation of the two truss planes + their lacing

anno.doc: annotation density: deflection diagram, dimension line, force callouts, legend, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian cyanotype / aged engraved plate / additive x-ray ghost / fea (members dissolve into pure force-coloured bars on clinical black)

seed.doc: truss type (Warren/Warren+verticals/Pratt/Howe), depth ratio, load phasing

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
